description: Files whose change can alter a persisted recommendation. Shared by check-policy-drift.mjs (POLICY_VERSION bump gate, ADR-0010) and scripts/engine_impact.py (engine-simulation trigger, ADR-0052 D-CI) so the two gates cannot drift apart. `relocations` ({ from, to, reason }) records behaviour-identical ADR-0052 module moves; check-policy-drift.mjs accepts a declared move without a POLICY_VERSION bump only when it proves the moved file and every changed production source executable-syntax-identical after import-specifier normalisation (ADR-0010 2026-10-25 amendment). Entries whose from no longer exists at the comparison base are stale and may be pruned.

files.reason: Occupational-load magnitudes and baseline discounts affect the live fatigue input.
Claim selection changes the persisted recommendation audit's provenance contract.
Weekly allocation reservations and exact-candidate ordering can change which sessions enter a persisted recommendation, even when planner.ts is unchanged.
Completed evidence changes future objective state and fatigue replay. A selectable estimator here is policy even though it sits upstream of the ranking modules.

Maps the persisted check-in/goals/settings into SubjectiveInput and UserContext (painFlag, restrictedModalities, clinicalFlagActive) before rules.ts runs, so a change can alter a persisted decision exactly as a change to rules.ts does.

Structured injury composition creates hard modality/category/guardrail restrictions before rules.ts evaluates the shared safety envelope; guarded beside the adapter so an injury mapping change cannot silently keep an old persisted policy identity.
ADR-0019: adjudication decides what an externally-planned athlete is told to do.
ADR-0019: the derived cost feeds the adjudication ceilings.
ADR-0020: once subjective drift is enabled, the baseline estimator is part of the deciding function even though it lives outside rules.ts.
ADR-0023: authored session replacement and addition gates directly alter live recommendations.
PR #292/#295: the evergreen requirement/packing/coverage pipeline decides which adaptations are required vs droppable and which concrete workouts satisfy them.
#757: the athlete-relative aerobic_volume floor decides which sessions earn exact weekly coverage, the first ranking key.
Decides which history window feeds athlete-state inference and fatigue/objective bookkeeping; the established-history fix changed live recommendations here without touching rules.ts.
The legacy template catalog and the coverage-role-to-workout mapping decide which concrete sessions can satisfy a required adaptation at all.
#804: progressive mechanical and impact exposure capability and progression rules.
Confirmed progression overrides alter the active dose of the selected catalog workout, including authored event/taper roles outside evergreen packing.
